text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Friday:

SAir Group's Swissotel unit sold its 99 percent stake in four U.S. hotels to Blackstone Real Estate Advisors, but will continue to manage the properties, located in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago and New York.
Swiss researchers have recommended the medically-supervised prescription of heroin to drug users who do not respond to other types of therapies.
Geneva, following in the footsteps of Berlin and Zurich, has organised a techno-party street parade. The parade is scheduled for August 9.
